image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow/gold posterior body. A distinct white vertical bar separates the black and yellow regions near the gill cover. The dorsal fin is visible along the top edge, showing a gradient from green/yellow to black. The background is a blurry, dark underwater environment.
